verdict.rationale: Braintrust has official SDKs in both languages: a Python SDK with a versioned reference (docs-38) and the `wrap_openai` drop-in wrapper that auto-logs LLM calls (docs-36), plus a first-party JavaScript SDK repo (gh-1, gh-2). Its instrumentation docs describe capturing full traces of inputs, outputs, latency, tokens and metadata (docs-1, docs-15). Missing for 10: JS/TS-specific tracing evidence (the JS repo snippets show only evals, not tracing wrappers), detailed side-by-side instrumentation docs for both languages, and independent hands-on corroboration.
